name: The Orchard Campsite, Croyde
accommodation: 24 pitches for tents and VW-style vans (no hook-ups); B&B also available
suitableFor: Campers and van owners, including dog owners
beachAccess: About a 10-minute walk to Croyde beach
confirmedFeatures: Hot showers including outdoor shower, toilets, BBQ bricks, washing-up area, drying area, freezer block exchange, WiFi, charging lockers, staff on site 24 hours
overview: A 24-pitch campsite at Bridge Farm in the heart of Croyde village, around ten minutes' walk from the beach and a short drive from Saunton Sands. Tents and VW-style vans can park by their pitch, and there is an outdoor hot shower and drying area.
surfTripFit: The outdoor hot shower and drying line suit wetsuit days, and you can choose between Croyde and Saunton depending on conditions.
